import json
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Query
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

app = FastAPI(title='Product API')

class ProductCreate(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., min_length=1, max_length=200)
    price: float = Field(..., gt=0)
    in_stock: bool = True
    category: str = Field(..., min_length=1)

class ProductResponse(ProductCreate):
    id: int

products_db = []

@app.post('/products/', response_model=ProductResponse, status_code=201)
async def create_product(product: ProductCreate):
    new_id = len(products_db) + 1
    product_dict = {'id': new_id, **product.model_dump()}
    products_db.append(product_dict)
    return product_dict

@app.get('/products/', response_model=list[ProductResponse])
async def list_products(category: str | None = None):
    if category:
        return [p for p in products_db if p['category'] == category]
    return products_db

@app.get('/products/{product_id}', response_model=ProductResponse)
async def get_product(product_id: int):
    for p in products_db:
        if p['id'] == product_id:
            return p
    raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail='Product not found')

client = TestClient(app)
r = client.post('/products/', json={'name': 'Laptop', 'price': 999.99, 'in_stock': True, 'category': 'electronics'})
data = r.json()
ordered = {'id': data['id']}
ordered.update({k: v for k, v in data.items() if k != 'id'})
print('POST /products/ →', json.dumps(ordered))
